text: Right-only inversion of saved 40-update residuals reaches about 1e-9 mm in one composition, while the reverse sampled composition remains 0.446 and 1.757 mm on the two development sentinels. This identifies interpolation error that extra inverse iterations cannot remove. Implemented final endpoint admission with explicit image-derived regions and coverage checks, plus optional accumulated-displacement smoothing before objective and topology admission. Four frozen sentinel lanes compare smoothing and wider boundary taper without changing tolerances.
